answer:
Use the `-j` or `--max-concurrency` flag with `promptfoo eval`. The option is described as "Maximum number of concurrent API calls" [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md].

For example, this run limits the eval to one concurrent call:

```bash
promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --max-concurrency 1
```

The OSWorld guide uses the same flag in an eval command: "promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache --filter-metadata app=libreoffice_calc --max-concurrency 1" [promptfoo/site/docs/guides/evaluate-osworld-with-inspect.md].

The context doesn't show whether this setting can also be placed in `promptfooconfig.yaml`, or whether it has an environment variable. I don't know those details from the provided documents.
